SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_diff
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.DOCType
HAVING 
    avg_diff > (SELECT AVG(EnrollmentDiff) FROM 
                 (SELECT 
                      f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EnrollmentDiff
                  FROM 
                      frpm f
                  JOIN 
                      schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
                  WHERE 
                      f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded')) AS avg_diff;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_diff
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.DOCType
HAVING 
    avg_diff > (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM 
                 (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_diff
                  FROM frpm f2
                  JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
                  WHERE f2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
                  GROUP BY s2.School, s2.DOCType));

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    AVG(f.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) AS AvgDiff
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.DOCType
HAVING 
    ABS(AvgDiff) > (SELECT AVG(ABS(f2.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f2.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)])) 
                    FROM frpm f2 
                    WHERE f2.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded');

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - Enrollment (K-12)) AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm
    WHERE Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT s.School, s.DOCType, (s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - s.Enrollment (K-12)) AS diff
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - s.Enrollment (K-12)) > (SELECT avg_difference FROM avg_diff);

WITH AverageDifference AS (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment('Ages 5-17') - Enrollment('K-12')) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm
    WHERE Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    f.Enrollment('Ages 5-17') - f.Enrollment('K-12') AS diff
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded' AND
    f.Enrollment('Ages 5-17') - f.Enrollment('K-12') > (SELECT avg_diff FROM AverageDifference);

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType, AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - AVG(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS diff
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY s.School, s.DOCType
HAVING diff > (
    SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) - AVG(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
);

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    ABS(f.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) AS EnrollmentDifference
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded'
HAVING 
    ABS(f.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(ABS(f2.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f2.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]))
        FROM 
            frpm f2
        JOIN 
            schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE 
            f2.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded'
    )
ORDER BY 
    EnrollmentDifference DESC;

SELECT 
    frpm.School Name,
    frpm.DOCType,
    ABS(frpm.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - frpm.Enrollment (K-12)) AS EnrollmentDifference
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE

HAVING

        FROM 
            frpm
        JOIN 
            schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
        WHERE 
            frpm.Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
    )
ORDER BY 
    EnrollmentDifference DESC;
